title: Red Hat Security Advisory: webkit2gtk3 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
description: Multiple security vulnerabilities affecting the WebKitGTK port of the WebKit rendering engine on the GTK platform have been addressed in an update for Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support. The issues include out-of-bounds reads, buffer overflows, use-after-free, uninitialized resource usage, and race conditions in components such as Skia and ANGLE used by chromium-browser. These vulnerabilities have been rated with a high security impact by Red Hat Product Security. The update also fixes a crash issue affecting WebKitWebProcess related to Cisco Secure Client login window. Users of affected Red Hat Enterprise Linux 9.8 Extended Update Support versions should apply the update to mitigate these issues.
